note: scenario target-manydocs-2000x5 run 3 - rust server 0.2.0-dev on sqlite - server and loadgen on same machine
latency_note: latency_ms is service time: from just before an edit is sent until its answer arrives. latency_from_schedule_ms is measured from the slot the edit was scheduled for (a fixed interval per editor), so a stalled server also shows as waiting for the edits queued behind the stall; no slot is skipped. An edit with no answer after 30 s counts as a timeout and enters both as 30000 ms. For `open`, first_open_ms is the first, cold sample and latency_ms covers the remaining ones.
